title: CareSignal VBC intelligence question catalog
status: Synthetic development registry. Capability is explicit per question; question text is not proof of implementation.

priorities.P0: First validation slice; not a claim of current support
priorities.P1: Subsequent capability requiring its listed data and validation

evidence: exact supporting span or structured value with units
decision: eligible / ineligible / already addressed / appropriate hold / needs review / insufficient evidence
action: expected benefit separately from financial effect

kdigo.title: KDIGO CKD evaluation and management
kdigo.use: Versioned CKD guideline source; clinical criteria require specialist approval.

acc_hf.title: ACC HFrEF consensus pathway
acc_hf.use: HFrEF treatment framework; not a machine-executable dosing protocol.

sepsis.title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign adult guidelines 2026
sepsis.use: Clinical review framework for sepsis and recovery; intervention efficacy must be evaluated separately.

palliative.title: CAPC palliative care definition
palliative.use: Serious illness, symptom burden and quality of life; palliative care can accompany disease-directed treatment.

snf.title: CMS SNF quality measures and technical information
snf.use: Public measure definitions; not sufficient alone for patient-specific or DRG-specific matching.

radv.title: CMS Medicare Advantage risk adjustment data validation
radv.use: Documentation support for submitted diagnoses; use applicable program/year rules.

access.title: CMS ACCESS
access.use: Program status and entry point to authoritative application and payment specifications.

cjrx.title: CMS CJR-X
cjrx.use: Finalized model, implementation date and episode framework.

hrsa.title: HRSA downloadable workforce and shortage data
hrsa.use: Context on local supply and shortages; not live appointment availability.

heat.title: CDC heat and heat-related illness tracking
heat.use: Area/time environmental context; not proof of individual exposure or cause.

air.title: AirNow API documentation
air.use: Air-quality observations and forecasts; validate coverage, timing and data quality.

transit.title: FTA GTFS reporting information
transit.use: Discover transit feeds; local schedules and accessibility must be verified.
